en: Black‑and‑white street view showing a brick and stone cinema building with the sign "BIOGRAFEN" above the main entrance. The structure has arched windows and a mansard-style roof with small oval dormer windows. To the left are ornate wooden townhouses lining the street, where a few pedestrians stand on an unpaved road. At the bottom of the image, printed captions read "Elverum." on the left and "Eneret: Alf Furhreims Boghandel." on the right. Handwritten notes at the top label some buildings or people.
